hints.content:
The function is decreasing, so the left Riemann sum will overestimate the actual area:

![The graph of function g has the shaded area divided into 7 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top left corner and rises above the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/1e436abc11460cd9b44bbc351e1fbde4c8fb8246)

And the right Riemann sum will underestimate:

![The graph of function g has the shaded area divided into 7 rectangles of equal width. Each rectangle touches the curve at the top right corner and is below the curve.](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/c0197350184035b777782c32b9a29d3d18213b3e)

Here are the areas ordered from least to greatest:

* Right Riemann sum
* Actual area under the curve
* Left Riemann sum
